Attempt Type Coercion for Expanded Tag Columns

Source: R/extract_tags.R
dot-coerce_tag_columns.Rd

Internal helper for extract_tags. Iterates over each character column and attempts to coerce it to a more specific type in priority order: numeric → logical → date-time (ISO 8601). Coercion is only applied when it does not introduce new NA values. If all coercion attempts fail, the column is retained as character and a warning() is emitted identifying the column name and the values that prevented coercion.

Usage

.coerce_tag_columns(df)

Arguments

df

A dataframe of character columns (the expanded tag columns).

Value

The same dataframe with columns coerced where it is safe to do so.
